luiskr.com / core/utils/string / splitDrawSentences

function splitDrawSentences(text): string[];

Defined in: core/utils/string.ts:173

Splits a paragraph into sentence runs for staged draw-text reveals. A boundary is terminal punctuation (. ! ? …) followed by whitespace — mid-word dots without a following space ("Three.js", CDN paths) never split. The delimiter whitespace is consumed; callers join runs with a real space node so inline wrapping is preserved. Text with no boundary returns as a single run; empty input returns [].

Parameters

text

string

Raw paragraph text.

Returns

string[]

Sentence strings in document order, whitespace-trimmed.
